snippet.title: Fate Trigger Cinematic Trailer | Gamescom ONL 2025 First Reveal
snippet.description:
Add to Wishlist now.  Early Access in Q1 2026.
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3092530/Fate_Trigger/

Fate Trigger brand-new cinematic trailer revealed from gamescom Open Night Live 2025.

Join FATE TRIGGER, the anime-style tactical hero shooter! Dive into a dynamic world of floating islands, become a sharpshooter with unique character skills, and engage in thrilling life-or-death showdowns!

Follow on Twitter: https://x.com/FateTrigger_EN
